item.text: {"ticker":"META","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. The MCP FCFF valuation for Meta Platforms, Inc. estimates value per share at $783.67 versus an observed market quote of $610.26. Growth assumptions start from $214.96B revenue, use 17.58% revenue growth for years 2-5, then fade toward 4.60% terminal growth; the mapped Software (Internet) growth anchor has 0.574 confidence. Margins are high but modeled to normalize: operating margin is 42.23% in the base year, 42.00% next year, and converges to a 32.90% target. Reinvestment is modeled through sales-to-capital of 3.55x in years 1-5 and 1.77x in years 6-10, with a 47.76% terminal reinvestment rate. Cost of capital begins at 10.05% and fades to 9.63%, using a 4.60% risk-free rate and Damodaran ERP inputs. Terminal value is a large driver: terminal cash flow is $198.81B, terminal value is $3.95T, and present value of terminal value is $955.75B compared with $1.04T present value of forecast cash flows. Data caveats: Yahoo Finance coverage can be missing, stale, or insufficient; rates are percentages; sales-to-capital is a multiple; and single-variable market expectation checks vary one lever at a time while leaving the rest fixed."}
